explanation: The smaller drum is played with the dominant hand and the larger bass drum with the other. A black patch of paste on each head gives the tabla its ringing tone.

claims.text: The tabla is a pair of hand drums.
The tabla is not a pair of flutes, bells or cymbals.
The smaller tabla drum is usually played with the dominant hand and the larger bass drum with the other hand.
Each tabla head carries a black patch of paste, the syahi, which shapes its ringing tone.
